ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: MAHALLAK uses the camera to photograph your items and the places you keep them. Photos stay on your device unless you turn on cloud backup.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To pick a photo of an item or place from your library.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MAHALLAK uses the microphone for voice search. Audio is never stored or sent to our servers.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: To turn your spoken question into text and search your items.
